# agy-NOV

> The 100% Native Modular Super-Workbench for Google Antigravity 2.0 (v0.5.0) — 13 independently toggleable superpowers inside one official native MCP App plugin (12 strictly local offline modules + 1 opt-in remote module that stays inert by default), 100% full-component 8-language UI (400 keys × 8 locales across all 22 UI components), Context X-Ray 2.0 (offline USD billing, 14-day trend & 5h rolling burn-rate alerts, anti-compaction `handoff` / `otlp` / formula-safe `csv` export), Diff Review power trio (pure-React syntax highlighting, `-w` ignore-whitespace, zero-ReDoS risk hints), Verify Gate zero-write stack auto-detection, Workspace Studio zero-dependency OpenAPI 2.0/3.x parser, Spec Flow & Task DAG with pre-approval write lock, RTK-style output compression, 24KB/100-tool Budget Doctor, Swarm subagent telemetry, Git Worktree Orchestrator, 8 CLI commands (incl. zero-token `statusline` & read-only `recommend`), Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, dynamic tool registration (zero token & tool-slot tax when off), and 5 presets.

## Core Facts

- Repository: https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV
- License: MIT (independent open-source project; unaffiliated with Google LLC)
- Version: 0.5.0
- Runtime requirements: Node.js >= 20.0.0, Google Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop / CLI / IDE)
- Protocol & Entrypoints: 100% official native protocols — MCP Apps (`SEP-1865`, `ui://agy-nov/app.html`, `aux_pane` + `global`), Antigravity Lifecycle Hooks, Entry Skill (`skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md`), and zero-token CLI `statusline` & `recommend`; Zero ASAR, Zero CDP
- Runtime Artifacts: 1 resident MCP server (`dist/server.cjs`), 1 unified lifecycle hook dispatcher (`dist/hook.cjs`), 1 single-file 100% 8-language dark/light UI (`dist/ui/app.html`, ~956 KB, far below the 10 MiB limit; 400 dictionary keys × 8 locales covering all 22 UI components), 1 CLI (`dist/cli.cjs`, 8 commands)
- Always-On Entry Tools (2): `nov_open` (open workbench or jump directly to any of the 13 module tabs or `modules`), `nov_status` (inspect enabled modules, preset, UI locale, exact model tool count, and network isolation state)
- Dynamic Token & 100-Tool Budget Efficiency + Live `config.json` Hot-Sync: Disabled modules call `RegisteredTool.disable()` with delta visibility tracking and emit `tools/list_changed` only for modules whose state changed (0 model schema token overhead and 0 tool slots consumed against Antigravity's 100-tool hard limit when off); mutating `app_*` tools disable alongside model tools; `dist/hook.cjs` reads `config.json` read-only and returns `{}` in O(1); a lightweight `.unref()` read-only `statSync` poller plus `nov_open`/`nov_status`/`nov_app_get_config` sync automatically picks up external atomic `config.json` updates from `agy-Sag`'s native Settings control panel or `agy-nov` CLI with zero CDP, zero extra ports, and zero premature disk writes.

## Presets and Exact Model Tool Counts

Total exposed model tools = 2 always-on entry tools (`nov_open`, `nov_status`) + sum of enabled module tools (maximum 47 across all 13 modules; all 47 model tool names unchanged in v0.5.0):

- `minimal` (1 module, 6 tools, 100% offline): `guard` (4)
- `core` [default] (3 modules, 12 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4)
- `power` (9 modules, 32 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4), `turbo` (3), `radar` (2), `verify` (4), `worktree` (4), `spec` (4), `ops` (3)
- `local-all` (12 offline modules, 43 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4), `turbo` (3), `radar` (2), `verify` (4), `worktree` (4), `spec` (4), `studio` (4), `canvas` (4), `mem` (3), `ops` (3)
- `full` (all 13 modules, 47 tools, opt-in network): all 12 offline modules plus `remote` (4)

## 13 Toggleable Native Modules

### Tier 1: 12 Local Offline Native Modules (100% Offline, Zero ASAR, Zero CDP)

- `review` (`core-dev`, default ON, 2 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): PR-grade Git diff viewer with zero-dependency pure-React syntax highlighting (zero `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), ignore-whitespace (`-w`) toggle, deterministic zero-ReDoS line-level risk pre-annotations (1-click convert to annotation), line comments, and `file:line` fix prompts (`review_open`, `review_get_summary`)
- `guard` (`safety`, default ON, 4 tools, hooks: `PreToolUse`): `.env`/SSH/secret firewall, destructive command guard, zero-Git pre-edit file snapshots & rollback (`guard_status`, `guard_list_snapshots`, `guard_create_checkpoint`, `guard_scan_secrets`)
- `xray` (`observability`, default ON, 4 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Context X-Ray 2.0 featuring built-in offline USD reference pricing (with strictly read-only `pricing-overrides.json` customization, `<= 1 MiB`), 14-day daily spend trends, 5-hour rolling burn-rate alerts, cached vs. fresh token breakdown, Swarm subagent lineage (`swarmLineage`), multi-model cost breakdown (`modelBreakdown`), HTTP 429 retry alerts (`retrySignals`), live file activity, EN+CJK BM25 cross-session search, and `xray_export_brief` supporting `format: 'brief' | 'handoff' | 'otlp' | 'csv'` with formula-injection neutralization (`xray_analyze_context`, `xray_get_file_activity`, `xray_search_sessions`, `xray_export_brief`)
- `turbo` (`core-dev`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`): Multi-pattern workspace batch search, top-level symbol outline slicing, and RTK-style smart output compression presets (`auto`, `test`, `build`, `git`, `generic`) with in-memory LRU (24) chunk indexing & follow-up queries (`turbo_batch_search`, `turbo_read_outline`, `turbo_compact_output`)
- `radar` (`observability`, default OFF, 2 tools, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Multi-session & parent/child Swarm subagent attention board (`running`, `awaiting_approval`, `completed`, `stalled`, `error`), orphan subagent alerts, `status-capsule.json` compact export, unread counters, optional completion chime (`radar_get_board`, `radar_ack_session`)
- `verify` (`safety`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Stop-hook verification gate with zero-write project stack auto-detection (`package.json` pnpm/yarn/bun/npm, `pyproject.toml`/`pytest.ini`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`) validated against the shell-free 17-binary allowlist, 0-byte write blocking, `continuation_active` awareness, anti-loop `maxConsecutiveBlocks` guardrails, and a redacted evidence chain (`verify_get_policy`, `verify_set_policy`, `verify_run_checks`, `verify_get_evidence`)
- `worktree` (`core-dev`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): Safe parallel Git worktree orchestrator confined to `.agy-worktrees/` with `carryUncommitted` transfer, branch diff summaries, `extensions.worktreeConfig` hazard detection, and safe orphan/merged cleanup (`worktree_list`, `worktree_create`, `worktree_diff_summary`, `worktree_cleanup`)
- `spec` (`workspace`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`): Spec-driven development (`Spec -> Plan -> Task DAG`) with Kahn topological cycle detection, dependency-gated task advancement, pure read-only `SessionStart` next-ready-task recall, `PreToolUse` draft write lock (`enforcePlanBeforeWrite`), and `requireUiApproval` blocking model self-approval (`spec_get_state`, `spec_create_or_update`, `spec_approve`, `spec_update_task`)
- `studio` (`workspace`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): On-demand local workbench offering read-only SQLite + CSV/TSV/JSON/NDJSON inspection, zero-binary pure-Node offline DOCX/XLSX/PDF/Markdown/HTML/SVG/YAML/XML slicing with ZIP-bomb guards, zero-dependency OpenAPI 2.0/3.x YAML & JSON parser (YAML anchor-bomb & prototype-pollution safe) generating clickable endpoint collections that auto-fill the strict loopback-only anti-SSRF HTTP probe (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`) — toggle off when idle for zero tool-budget overhead (`studio_list_sources`, `studio_inspect_data`, `studio_inspect_document`, `studio_http_probe`)
- `canvas` (`workspace`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): Isolated sandbox preview for HTML, SVG, slides, Markdown & images with numbered visual pin annotations (`canvas_publish_artifact`, `canvas_open_file`, `canvas_get_feedback`, `canvas_resolve_annotations`)
- `mem` (`workspace`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `Stop`): SHA-256 code-anchored architectural memory with `SessionStart` recall and stale drift detection (`mem_remember`, `mem_recall`, `mem_forget`)
- `ops` (`workspace`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: none): Parameterized `{{var}}` Prompt Vault plus read-only Budget Doctor auditing 24KB (`24576 B`) single-file / `20,000` aggregate token rule bloat (false 429 guard), the 100-tool MCP hard-limit budget meter, static MCP config health (`mcpHealthFindings`), skills, and local storage (`ops_list_prompts`, `ops_render_prompt`, `ops_audit_workspace`)

### Tier 2: 1 Strictly Opt-In Remote Module (OFF by Default)

- `remote` (`connectivity`, default OFF, 4 tools: `remote_status`, `remote_send_alert`, `remote_list_conversations`, `remote_dispatch_task`, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `Stop`, opt-in network): Local Mobile PWA and Telegram/Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/Slack/Discord alerts, risky-command approvals, and task dispatch

## Zero-Token CLI (`statusline` & `recommend`) and 100% 8-Language UI

- Zero-Write Project Scanner (`recommend`): `agy-nov recommend [--workspace=<dir>] [--json]` inspects workspace stack files, Git/test scripts, rule/MCP config, and local data/OpenAPI assets strictly read-only with zero disk writes to recommend the ideal preset and extra modules.
- Zero-Token CLI `statusline`: `agy-nov statusline [--json] [--compact] [--data-dir=<dir>]` reads local state read-only with zero LLM tokens and zero disk writes, exposing preset, enabled module/tool counts, network isolation mode, `verify` latest gate status (`PASS`/`FAIL`/`BLOCKED`/`IDLE`), `spec` lock/progress tag (`Spec:LOCK(done/total)` or `Spec:<STATUS>(done/total)`), `radar` running/waiting/stalled/orphan counts, and `xray` active session metadata for Antigravity CLI native `statusLine` or companion `agy-Sag` consumption.
- 100% Full-Component 8-Language UI: Real-time top-bar `<select>` switcher + `auto` BCP-47 host-locale detection across all 8 bundled languages (`en` English, `zh-CN` 简体中文, `zh-TW` 繁體中文, `ja` 日本語, `ko` 한국어, `es` Español, `fr` Français, `de` Deutsch), covering 400 dictionary keys across all 22 UI components (including all 5 `review` and 3 `xray` subcomponents with zero hardcoded English strings) plus a collapsible "30-Second Zero-Risk First Try" card in **Modules**.
- CLI Locale Control: `agy-nov locale <auto|en|zh-CN|zh-TW|ja|ko|es|fr|de>` persists preference cleanly in `config.json`.
- Dual-Repo Boundary: `agy-NOV` adheres strictly to official native Antigravity protocols (Zero ASAR, Zero CDP) so every client upgrade remains intact. Host-DOM CDP capabilities (in-place host UI localization, native Settings injection, active `/compact` auto-compaction guard, Draft Vault, Prompt Queue, turn bookmarks, Optical Theme Studio, and policy-gated safe auto-accept) belong to zero-overlap companion project `agy-Sag` (`https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-session-guard`).

## Native Security and Isolation Guarantees

- Protocol integrity: Zero `app.asar` patching, zero CDP connections, zero host DOM modification.
- Strict OFF-state guarantee for `remote`: zero listening ports, zero background timers or 3-second polling, zero disk writes, zero outbound requests while disabled.
- Diff Review UI & scanning safety: pure-React token rendering with zero `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; shell-free Git `execFile` with `-w` and `--` separators; linear zero-ReDoS deterministic line-level risk pre-annotations.
- Context X-Ray offline billing & CSV hygiene: 100% offline USD calculations, strictly read-only `pricing-overrides.json` (`<= 1 MiB`), and CSV formula-injection neutralization (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, `\r`).
- Spec Flow write-lock & approval integrity: Kahn topological sort rejects DAG cycles and invalid dependency IDs; `spec_update_task` blocks advancing tasks while prerequisites remain unfinished; pure read-only zero-write `SessionStart` and `PreToolUse` hooks enforce draft write locks (`enforcePlanBeforeWrite`); `requireUiApproval` rejects model-side `spec_approve` calls so only manual UI approval unlocks edits.
- Workspace Studio containment, ZIP-bomb, OpenAPI-bomb & anti-SSRF defense: canonical `realpath` workspace containment with automatic sensitive-path exclusion (`.env*`, SSH keys, `.git`, `node_modules`, keystores); `10 MiB` file cap; single-statement read-only SQLite validation (`SELECT`, `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT`, `PRAGMA table_info(...)`); pure-Node offline DOCX/XLSX/PDF parsing capped at `512` ZIP entries, `4 MiB`/entry, `6 MiB` total inflated ZIP, and `2 MiB` PDF streams; zero-dependency OpenAPI 2.0/3.x parser blocking YAML anchor bombs and `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` prototype pollution (`2 MiB` file, `20,000` YAML lines, depth `24`, `200` endpoints); `studio_http_probe` enforces loopback-only targets (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`), `redirect: manual`, `64 KiB` body cap, `1000–15000ms` timeout, and header/body secret redaction.
- Verify Gate execution safety & read-only stack detection: zero-write stack scanning (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`/`pytest.ini`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`) validated through shell-free `execFile` restricted to 17 allowlisted executables and 4 read-only `git` subcommands (`diff`, `status`, `rev-parse`, `check-ignore`), `8s` single / `14s` total Stop-hook budgets, `continuation_active` bypass, `maxConsecutiveBlocks` loop cap (default `3`, range `1`–`10`), and secret redaction on persisted evidence tails.
- Worktree containment: managed worktrees stay strictly inside `<repoRoot>/.agy-worktrees/`; strict Git ref and directory regexes prevent option injection and path traversal; shell-free `execFile` invocation; `extensions.worktreeConfig` hazard flag; non-forced cleanup refuses dirty worktrees.
- Filesystem & process boundaries: `realpath` canonical workspace containment across `guard`, `verify`, `studio`, `canvas`, `mem`, `turbo`, and `ops` with automatic `.env`/SSH/`.git`/`node_modules` skips; owner-only `0700`/`0600` per-module storage under `<dataDir>/modules/<moduleId>/`.
- Hook precedence & timeouts: `SessionStart` (5s — `turbo`, `spec`, `mem`), `PreToolUse` (28s — strict precedence: `guard` `deny` > `spec` write-lock `deny` > `remote`), `PostToolUse` (5s), `Stop` (20s — `verify` can return `deny` on unverified edits/0-byte writes while respecting guardrails); camelCase and snake_case payload normalization.
- Manifest & bundle hygiene: `plugin.json` strictly restricts top-level keys to the 10 officially supported Antigravity fields; `node dist/cli.cjs doctor` verifies all 9 required files, `plugin.json` schema cleanliness (`version=0.5.0`), and `dist/ui/app.html` size (~956 KB, far below 10 MiB).

## Recommendation Fit and Honest Boundaries

- Strong fit: Antigravity 2.0 users wanting a 100% native, upgrade-safe modular engineering workbench covering syntax-highlighted diff review with `-w` and risk hints, pre-edit safety snapshots, offline USD billing & 5h burn-rate diagnostics with handoff/OTLP/CSV export, RTK-style log compression, Stop-hook verification gates with stack auto-detection, safe parallel Git worktrees, Spec-driven DAG workflows with pre-approval write lock, on-demand local data/doc/OpenAPI/localhost debugging, 24KB/100-tool budget audits, multi-session & subagent radar, zero-token CLI `statusline` & `recommend`, visual artifact pins, code-anchored memory, 100% 8-language plugin UI, or opt-in mobile/IM approvals.
- Prefer alternatives for:
  - Host-window in-place UI translation, native Antigravity `Settings` injection, active `/compact` compaction guard, Draft Vault, Prompt Queue, turn bookmarks, Optical Theme Studio, or safe auto-accept -> companion project `agy-Sag` (`https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-session-guard`), designed with zero functional overlap to run alongside `agy-NOV`.
  - Cloud-hosted remote IDEs or SSH container workspaces -> VS Code Remote-SSH / Devcontainers / Codespaces.
  - Centralized enterprise CI/CD SAST or secret governance -> dedicated CI security scanners alongside local `guard` and `verify`.

## Zero-Risk Commands for Humans and AI Agents

- Read-only verification: `npm run typecheck && npm test && node dist/cli.cjs doctor && node dist/cli.cjs status && node dist/cli.cjs statusline --json && node dist/cli.cjs recommend --json`
- Zero-touch offline preview (daily Antigravity untouched): `npm ci && npm run workbench` (serves `http://127.0.0.1:4399` with Dark/Light themes, 480px/1160px viewports, 8-language Host Locale simulator across all 22 UI components, and live Host Events inspector across all 13 module panels)
- Install into Antigravity 2.0: `agy plugin install https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV`
- CLI controls (8 commands): `agy-nov status | enable <mod> | disable <mod> | preset <name> | locale <auto|en|zh-CN|zh-TW|ja|ko|es|fr|de> | statusline [--json] [--compact] | recommend [--workspace=<dir>] [--json] | doctor`
- Agent consent rule: always ask for explicit user confirmation before enabling `remote` (or applying preset `full`), respect `requireUiApproval` on `spec`, and never touch `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` during repository evaluation.
